text:
Jordan: Quick shoutout — massive thanks to Priya and Miguel for saving the client demo AV snafu this morning 🙌
Priya: wait what? I was making tea and suddenly became AV support lol :sweat_smile:
Miguel: cables, duct tape, and blind optimism — happy it worked out :grin:
Sam: Miguel's cable-lasso technique is underrated 😂
Tanya: Also huge props to eng-infra for the fast rollback script. Saved the dashboard from flapping. :raised_hands:
ops-bot: Deploy 2024-11-07_09:12 rolled back to release-2.14 by @eng-infra (automation notice)
Leah: Sending a small treat pack to the ops table — stickers + tea vouchers. Drop a :wave: if you want one
Jordan: @Leah you're a legend. Sticker chain incoming :sparkles:
Priya: can we do a micro-poll — snack of the week? croissants / trail-mix / boba
Miguel: croissants for morale, boba for soul
Sam: boba vote here -> :thumbsup:
Tanya: trail-mix keeps me alive during oncalls :grimacing:
Jordan: tally so far: croissants 1, boba 1, trail-mix 1. tie chaos. anyone else?
Leah: placing order now — croissants majority by tie-breaker (courtesy of Jordan's promise of coffee) ☕
Priya: I'm taking the sticker pack if still available, thanks Leah!! :purple_heart:
Jordan: coffee + croissants on me tomorrow morning for the rescue crew — 8:45 foyer?
Sam: i'll be there. got a small 'thank you' note to stick on Miguel's laptop :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Miguel: pls no glitter on my laptop :sweat_smile:
Tanya: also, quick procedural note — can eng-infra add a short doc for the rollback steps? would be handy for next time
Jordan: great idea. @eng-infra can you?
ops-bot: Reminder: Document request created (#DOC-452) by Jordan
Leah: done — ordered, receipts to follow. ETA croissants 11:30
Priya: love that. thanks again team, small things go a long way :heart:
Jordan: closing this thread — huge gratitude all around. extra high-five emoji for everyone who jumped in :v:
